node.statement: The reduced dual witness data are the KKT/LP-dual variables for those three constraint families after removing centered-zero lower constraints d_i=p_i-p_u=0. Therefore every optimal hiddenness dual witness has lambda_f, alpha_i, beta_i>=0, sum_F lambda_f=1, sum_i beta_i=t, and the stationarity/balance equation sum_F lambda_f d_f + sum_i alpha_i d_i = sum_i beta_i d_i. The external validated lemma lem-hiddenness-dual-witness supplies at least one such optimal witness for hidden u.
